summary: Project creation (quick and AI-guided) follows the paper languages ticked on the page. Owner 2026-10-23: "勾选了汉语之后，创建还是使用英文，现在要适配中文啊". The guidance system prompt no longer hard-codes English keywords/queries: with 中文 and not 英文 the model is asked for Chinese terms (English acronyms inside Chinese terms allowed), with both for a mix (keywords about half each, queries one each), otherwise English as before. vet_keywords/vet_queries/clean_queries: 中文 without 英文 keeps Chinese suggestions (up to the normal limits, two Chinese queries), drops English ones when a Chinese one is left, keeps an all-English reply rather than an empty draft, and builds the query from the first two Chinese keywords when the reply only has English queries; items the person wrote or deleted are set aside before that judgement; the person's own items are never filtered. Prompt 1112 -> 1240 bytes. The empty 检索式 in the owner's screenshot could not be reproduced. Second commit: after a real-model dev run (40 turns; zh-only all Chinese, zh+en keywords all Chinese in 5 of 8 turns) the prompt asks for keywords alternating Chinese and English starting with Chinese, and the daily feed asks OpenAlex for the first three English keywords of a mixed project (Baidu keeps the Chinese ones); review fixes: no query rebuild when the model gave nothing usable, single Latin words kept in zh-only mode, term_in_text ignores spaces next to Chinese characters, the local fallback knows the languages. Prompt now 1287 bytes.
scope_note: Worktree creation-zh on main f6bf5b0. Critical: the project_guidance prompt changed (audit-budget skill). No new outbound data (languages was already in the request), no new call, no retry, no migration; no network, real key, real database or model call in any test. owner_approved stays false. Second commit adds the daily-feed keyword choice (app/service.py _feed_keywords) and ranking.term_in_text spacing; no new outbound data.

quantified.period: one project_guidance call, first turn of a guided conversation (18-character Chinese goal, no keywords, languages zh+en); input is the Gateway input_bound UTF-8 byte upper bound, output the registered 300-token reference; peak cache-miss prices (input $0.30/M, output $1.20/M); arithmetic, not a measurement

budget_impact.rationale: The system prompt grows from 1112 to 1287 bytes (language rule per ticked-language combination). No new call, trigger or retry; harness/budget.json estimates (reference input 1600, cap 2400) are unchanged because +175 bytes is inside them and they are estimates only since ADR 0037.
budget_impact.before: keywords/queries asked in English whatever was ticked
budget_impact.after: keywords/queries asked in the ticked languages; +175 bytes of prompt per call
budget_impact.developer_usage: First commit none. Second commit: no call by the implementing agent; the coordinator's owner-authorised real-model run before it used 22,250 tokens / $0.0099 (40 turns, developer ledger, outside the repository).

reviews.reviewer: Separate review agent (Opus), read-only, of the first commit: no blocking finding; its should-fix and nit findings fixed in the second commit and not re-reviewed

open_risks: Real-model run (40 turns, small sample): zh-only gave all-Chinese terms; zh+en keywords were all Chinese in 5 of 8 turns before the second commit. The alternating-keywords prompt and the English-first OpenAlex choice are NOT re-run on the real model. If the model still answers only English in 中文-only mode the English is kept by design.
The empty 检索式 in the owner's screenshot was not reproduced; the service always yields a query when keywords exist, so the cause may be elsewhere (older build, page state).

The beta learning-map hint still asks for English terms; the local fallback cannot extract keywords from a Chinese goal; OpenAlex in the daily feed takes the first three keywords, so with mixed languages their order decides.
The page code was not changed and not looked at in a browser.
The review fixes were not independently re-reviewed.
route_recall still takes the first three project keywords whatever their language; a person who deletes the rebuilt Chinese query and gets only English queries again has to write one themselves.
